# Last-Crown — The winner takes it all

> Last-Crown is a free retro pixel-art browser fighting game created by Mujahid Al Mahi and Shahariar Hossain Jibon. Engineered with Next.js 14, Phaser 3, and Colyseus, it features server-authoritative 60Hz 2D combat, frame-perfect parries, breakable command grabs, Crown Burst combo breakers, smartphone QR controllers for local 2-player battles, and online 1v1 rooms with WebRTC voice chat.

## Creators & Developers
- **Mujahid Al Mahi** (Co-Creator, Lead Systems & Game Physics Engineer):
  - Portfolio: https://mujahidmahi.me
  - GitHub: https://github.com/mujahidalmahi
  - Role: Engineered the deterministic 60Hz physics core, custom integer collision hitboxes, frame-cancel windows, responsive player controlling mechanics, and server-authoritative Colyseus netcode.
- **Shahariar Hossain Jibon** (Co-Creator, Lead UI/UX & Visual Designer):
  - Portfolio: https://portfolio-v2-smoky-phi.vercel.app/
  - GitHub: https://github.com/ShahariarJibon
  - Role: Designed the 16-bit retro visual identity, responsive multi-device layout, smartphone touch controller interface, arena cinematography, and retro audio-visual aesthetics.

## Game Overview
- **Canonical URL**: https://last-crown.top
- **Genre**: 2D Retro Browser Fighting Game / Medieval Action / Arcade
- **Technology Stack**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Phaser 3, Colyseus, WebRTC, Web Audio API
- **License**: Open Source (MIT) on GitHub (https://github.com/mujahidalmahi/last-crown)
- **Platforms**: Modern Web Browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) across PC, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android, and tablets.
- **Price**: 100% Free to play ($0), zero downloads or installations required.

## Key Game Mechanics
- **Deflection & Parry**: Activating block within 180ms of an incoming strike parries the blow completely, dealing 0 damage, restoring stamina, and staggering the attacker into a vulnerable punish window.
- **Stamina & Guard Break**: Blocking absorbs 75% incoming damage at the cost of stamina. Depleting stamina triggers a 450ms guard break stun.
- **Command Grab & Throw Tech**: Pressing Grab (`G` / touch button) initiates an unblockable close-range throw. Opponents have a 120ms tech window to press Grab and break the throw, shoving both combatants apart.
- **Crown Burst & Roman Cancel**: A 0–100 burst meter accumulates from taking damage and successful parries. Pressing Burst (`B` / touch button) breaks hitstun defensively with a 180px shockwave or cancels recovery in neutral with a speed surge.
- **Directional Influence (DI) & Tech Rolls**: Players can influence mid-air launch trajectories with directional keys and execute an invulnerable recovery roll upon hitting the ground by pressing Dash.

## Warrior Archetypes & Characters
- **Sir Cedric the Loyal (Knight)**: High defense, balanced attacks, Bastion Riposte passive restoring +20 SP on parry.
- **Grimwood the Savage (Marauder)**: High damage, berserker counter-hit attacks, Blood Siphon passive restoring +6 HP on clean counters.
- **Valerius the Swift (Duelist)**: High agility, low startup frames, rapid multi-hit slash combos.
- **Aurelia the Radiant (Vanguard)**: Heavy armor, extended reach, Super Armor passive absorbing light attacks during heavy strike windups.
- **The Shadow Sovereign (Final Boss)**: High speed, 130 HP, 125 SP, dual obsidian blades, and adaptive aggression.

## Game Modes
- **Arcade Gauntlet** (`/arcade`): 5-stage single-player campaign ladder culminating in "The Shadow Sovereign" boss fight.
- **Training Dojo** (`/training`): Competitive practice dojo with live frame data, dummy AI controls, and hitbox visualizers.
- **Solo Crucible** (`/game`): Instant single-player duels against 4 progressive AI difficulty tiers.
- **Couch Battle** (`/local`): Shared-screen 2-player battles using smartphone QR codes as wireless gamepads.
- **Online 1v1 Room** (`/room`): Server-authoritative multiplayer with private 6-letter room codes and built-in WebRTC voice chat.
